purpose: The standard every NUMERICAL capability record must follow so the Numerical Capability gate (execute stage) can call it as a research ACTION. The B-side cleans/curates the numerical capability library to this schema; argus_skill/verticals/physics/capabilities/numerical.json conforms to it as the reference example.
gate_checking_philosophy: The gate does NOT require every task to have parameter scans, neighbourhood sweeps, or finite-size scaling.
It checks: did Argus judge whether the numerical capability is applicable?
If applicable, did it execute the capability with artifact evidence?
If not executed, is the reason recorded?
If a claim (robust/protected/phase-diagram/universal) depends on it but it was not done, is the claim downgraded?

required_fields.description: Short name of the numerical research action.
How a dependent claim is downgraded if not done.
How to compare to the closest prior numerical treatment.

gate_binding.claim_cross_check: CLAIMS.csv robust/protected/stable claims require a used+evidenced robustness capability (NUM-003); phase-diagram/phase-boundary/universal/scan claims require a used+evidenced scan capability (NUM-004).
gate_binding.note: The capability's usage_question/evidence_question/claim_downgrade_if_missing map to the NUMERICAL_STUDY_PLAN.csv columns used_by_argus/evidence_file/... that gates/numerical.py verifies.
